title: Mandatory Tree Planting Provisions
previewText: In addition to the applicable underlying street tree planting requirements, tree planting provisions shall also apply to extensions or alterations, other than incidental alterations, involving 30 percent or more of the existing floor area of a building. For uses listed under Use Groups IV(B), IX(B), or X, the street tree planting requirements of Section 26-41 (Street Tree Planting) shall apply.
